description: Specs obs-dashboard-spec.v1.json accepts (valid) and refuses (invalid). Each invalid spec breaks one rule. obs-api's validation of an embedded copy should give the same answers. Not covered, because JSON Schema can't express them and obs-api checks them itself: the 256 KiB size limit, and unique panel ids, variable names and query refs.

valid.name: absolute time range, refresh and an empty variable list
metrics timeseries with every common option
metrics table on an instant vector with thresholds
stat with a sparkline, change and a panel time override
logs aggregate with a numeric attribute and two group-bys
logs aggregate without a filter or group-by
logs countDistinct over a well-known field
traces chart with errorRate and p95
traces errors grouped by status and kind
text panel with a description and empty markdown
application variable, multi with an array default
values from a metric label without match
values from a span resource attribute
table with a rowLink to a built-in dashboard and mappings

viz.noData: No data from cluster state. Turn on clusterState in the agent's chart.
